big_picture.title: Stock Market Falls But Nasdaq Holds Key Level; Anthropic IPO, Nvidia Earnings Loom
big_picture.excerpt: The stock market mostly fell but the Dow Jones index squeezed out a gain. Nvidia earnings and the Anthropic IPO are now due.
paragraphs: The stock market dipped Friday as the fallout from Jensen Huang's resignation continued, but the Nasdaq composite held a key level. Nvidia (NVDA) earnings and the stock market debut of artificial intelligence firm Anthropic now loom.

The Nasdaq fought its way back from session lows, but still dropped 0.9% Friday. The tech-heavy index notched a 2.3% gain for the week and encouragingly held support at its 200-day moving average. It now holds a gain for the year of 8.2%.
